{{Quote|What the frizz are we doing here?|[[Archyr Beil]]|<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
'''Frizz''' was an expletive, used in phrases like "whatever the frizz that means" and "what/why the frizz."<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> "Frizz off" was a phrase used to rudely tell someone to go away.<ref name="SkyeWalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>
